title: Fronius Solar Web Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fronius:solar
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by inverter_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Fronius inverter reading data has stopped arriving for a given inverter.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per inverter and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you when one part of your Fronius inverter reading feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
